scope: Matched learned versus frozen-identity joint AgentMixer at the accepted 1M matrix budget on both games. The earlier 200k Climbing validation remains failed and separate.
question: Does learning the mode-preserving joint modifier improve local execution relative to the same initialized policy with the modifier fixed at log scale zero?
expected_if_modifier_helps: Positive paired learned-minus-identity final local expected returns and/or better local learning-curve area or greedy reliability; outcomes can also be negative.
changes_from_selected: Only budget 200k to 1M and new training seeds for the learned arm. Identity differs only by modifier_enabled=False. Constant entropy and actor rates remain unchanged.
source_qualification: Current eight-module snapshot includes previously verified default-preserving runner changes. Exact short-case parity against the selected frozen source covers 12 cases; new modifier flag does not change the default path.

reporting.primary: For each game, mean paired difference in final local expected return, learned minus identity.
reporting.aggregate_gate: All 20 declared runs must complete with valid source/configuration/score audits before either game receives a paired aggregate.
reporting.uncertainty: 10,000 whole-pair bootstrap draws with private seed 1729 and pointwise 95% percentile intervals. Five seeds give limited precision; no family-wise or broad superiority claim.
reporting.missing_or_failed: Retain every seed; no replacements, selected peaks, development pooling or outcome-driven configuration changes.
reporting.historical_limit: Reconstructed joint modifier, networks and numerical guards remain explicit differences. Matching the 1M budget alone does not prove historical equivalence.

cost_per_arm.limitations: Planning estimate from Climbing learned-modifier runs; identity and Penalty runtime may differ. Failures/timeouts retained; no automatic retries.

scheduling: Each arm is one serial worker after the matching existing Prey worker21212197_i and before still-pending recurrent Prey21219719_i; at most four project workers total.
